## Load in hourly data for krill swarms, whale calls, sea ice and light

```{r Load and massage data, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())

library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(here)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
if(!require(plotly)) install.packages("purrr")
library(gratia)
library(knitr)

# Define data directory
data_dir <- "C:/Users/abbie_smi/OneDrive - Antarctic/Documents/GitHub/whale-krill-comparison/Smith-et-al-Phil-Trans-B"

##source log-normal CI function
func_path <- file.path(data_dir, "/log-normCIs.R")
source(func_path)

##get the data:
dat_file <- file.path(data_dir, "/TT_align_swarm_regioncells.csv")
dat <- read.csv(dat_file)

##processing
#times
dat$timeStamp=as.POSIXct(dat$timeVec,format= "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz='UTC')
dat$hour=as.numeric(format(dat$timeStamp, "%H"))
dat$day_of_year=as.numeric(format(dat$timeStamp, "%j"))
summary(dat$day_of_year)

#krill presence-absence
dat$krill_PA=0
dat$krill_PA[dat$rho_v>0]=1
table(dat$krill_PA)
#minimum detectable krill density:
min_det=min(dat$rho_v[dat$krill_PA==1])
dat$rho_min=dat$rho_v+min_det/2

#max krill density in an hour
max(dat$rho_v, na.rm = TRUE) #max density
dat$timeVec[max(dat$rho_v, na.rm = TRUE)] #when?
dat$Center_of_mass[max(dat$rho_v, na.rm = TRUE)] #when?


#deal with centre of mass NaN and assign a 'background value':
dat$Center_of_mass_min=200
dat$Center_of_mass_min[which(!is.nan(dat$Center_of_mass))]=
  dat$Center_of_mass[which(!is.nan(dat$Center_of_mass))]
plot(dat$Center_of_mass_min)

#rename ice variable
dat$ice = dat$Diff

```

## Observation time series 
```{r Observation time series}

dat$timeVec <- as.POSIXct(dat$timeVec)


# A. Solar (yellow) and Lunar (purple) Lux 
solar_max <- max(dat$solar_lux, na.rm = TRUE)
lunar_max <- max(dat$lunar_lux, na.rm = TRUE)
scale_factor <- solar_max / lunar_max

p1 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeVec)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = solar_lux), colour = "#FFD700", linewidth = 1) +  # dark yellow
  geom_line(aes(y = lunar_lux * scale_factor), colour = "#6A0DAD", linewidth = 1) +  # dark purple
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Solar (lux)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Lunar (lux)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "#FFD700"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#6A0DAD"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#6A0DAD"),
    axis.text.y.left   = element_text(color = "#FFD700")
  ) +
  ggtitle("a) Solar irradiance and Lunar illuminance")


# B. Ice Draft (dark grey, reversed y-axis)
p2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeVec, y = ice)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Sea ice draft (m)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggtitle("b) Sea ice draft")

# C. Centre of Mass scatter (rho_v colour, thickness size)
p3 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeVec, y = Center_of_mass,
                colour = rho_v, size = Thickness_mean)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +  # fully opaque points
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Centre of Mass (m)") +
  scale_colour_viridis(
    option = "plasma",
    na.value = "grey80",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = expression("Density (g m^3)") 
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), name = "Thickness (m)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "c) Krill swarms")

# D. Blue Whale Song Detections/hour (purple) 
p4 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeVec, y = Bm_Ant_ABZ)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#800080", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(y = "Detections/hr", title = "d) ABW song")

# E. Blue Whale Downsweeps/hour (magenta)
p5 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeVec, y = Bm_D)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#CC4678", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(y = "Detections/hr", title = "e) ABW downsweeps")

# F. Minke Whale Bioduck/hour (orange)
p6 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = timeVec, y = BD)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#FFA500", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(y = "Detections/hr", title = "f) AMW bioduck")

# Combine all plots vertically
combined_plot <- (
  p1 / p2 / p3 / p4 / p5 / p6
) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))

combined_plot

```



## Overlap in raw observations
Find the dates when ABW and AMW calls overlap at threshold of 10% of the max call detections per hour.
```{r Raw observations}
# Day-level total calls
whale_daily <- dat %>%
  group_by(day_of_year) %>%
  summarise(
    ABW_total = sum(Bm_Ant_ABZ, na.rm = TRUE),
    BD_total  = sum(BD, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Calculate 10th percentile thresholds for each species
thresholds <- whale_daily %>%
  summarise(
    ABW_thr = max(ABW_total, na.rm = TRUE)*0.1,
    BD_thr  = max(BD_total, na.rm = TRUE)*0.1
  )

# Identify overlapping days
overlap_days <- whale_daily %>%
  filter(ABW_total > thresholds$ABW_thr & BD_total > thresholds$BD_thr) %>%
  pull(day_of_year)

overlap_dates <- as.Date(overlap_days, origin = "2021-01-01")
overlap_days
overlap_dates

length(overlap_days)/365 *100

# Collapse consecutive dates into ranges (needed in final plots)
overlap_ranges <- overlap_dates %>%
  sort() %>%
  { data.frame(start = .[c(TRUE, diff(.) != 1)], 
               end = .[c(diff(.) != 1, TRUE)]) }


```


## Whale call GAMs

```{r Modelling, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
##Modelling
#gam for "ABW Song"

m1 <- gam(Bm_Ant_ABZ ~  
            s(hour, k=15,bs='cc') + 
            s(day_of_year, k=15,bs='cc')+
            s(solar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
            s(lunar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
            s(ice,k=6,bs='cr'),
          data=dat,
          method='ML',
          family=gaussian(link='log'),
          gamma=1.4,
          select=FALSE,
          knots=list(hour=c(0,24),day_of_year=c(0,365)))
summary(m1) 

#gam for "ABW Downsweeps"
m2 <- gam(Bm_D ~  
            s(hour, k=15,bs='cc') + 
            s(day_of_year, k=15,bs='cc')+
            s(solar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
            s(lunar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
            s(ice,k=6,bs='cr'),
          data=dat,
          method='ML',
          family=gaussian(link='log'),
          gamma=1.4,
          select=TRUE,
          knots=list(hour=c(0,24),day_of_year=c(0,365)))
summary(m2)

#gam for "AMW Bioduck"
m3 <- gam(BD ~  
            s(hour, k=15,bs='cc') + 
            s(day_of_year, k=15,bs='cc')+
            s(solar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
            s(lunar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
            s(ice,k=6,bs='cr'),
          data=dat,
          method='ML',
          family=gaussian(link='log'),
          gamma=1.4,
          select=TRUE,
          knots=list(hour=c(0,24),day_of_year=c(0,365)))
summary(m3)

#predictions for the call models (m1,m2 and  m3)
preds=data.frame(hour=mean(dat$hour),
                 day_of_year=0:365,
                 solar_lux=mean(dat$solar_lux,na.rm=T),
                 lunar_lux=mean(dat$lunar_lux,na.rm=T),
                 ice=mean(dat$ice,na.rm=T))
preds_m1=as.data.frame(predict(m1,newdata=preds,type='response',se.fit=TRUE))
preds_m1$model='Bm_Ant_ABZ'
preds_m2=as.data.frame(predict(m2,newdata=preds,type='response',se.fit=TRUE))
preds_m2$model='Bm_D'
preds_m3=as.data.frame(predict(m3,newdata=preds,type='response',se.fit=TRUE))
preds_m3$model='BD'
preds_all=rbind(preds_m1,preds_m2,preds_m3)
preds_all$day_of_year=preds$day_of_year
preds_all$lower=preds_all$fit-2*preds_all$se.fit
preds_all$upper=preds_all$fit+2*preds_all$se.fit

month_start_days <- c(1, 32, 60, 91, 121, 152, 182, 213, 244, 274, 305, 335)

#plot predictions of the call models:
ggplot(data=preds_all,aes(x=as.Date(day_of_year,origin='2021-01-01'),
                          y=fit,colour=model,group=model))+
  geom_line(linewidth=1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill=model),alpha=0.4,colour=NA)+
  facet_grid(model~., scales = "free_y")+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = '%b')+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
  labs(y='Predicted call rate, nbr/hr',x='Day of year')+
  theme(legend.position = 'top')


```


## Krill swarm GAMs

Here we model krill density using only environmental (non-krill non-whale) covariates. We also model centre of mass the same way. 

```{r Alternate krill models for density and centre of mass, fig.height=7.9, fig.width=6.3, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
# Krill swarm properties
mdensity <- gam(rho_min ~  
                  s(hour, k=15,bs='cc') + 
                  s(day_of_year, k=15,bs='cc')+
                  s(solar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
                  s(lunar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
                  s(ice,k=6,bs='cr'),
                data=dat,
                method='ML',
                family=Gamma(link='log'),
                gamma=1.4,
                select=TRUE,
                knots=list(hour=c(0,24),day_of_year=c(0,365)))
summary(mdensity)
gam.check(mdensity)

mcom= gam(Center_of_mass ~  
              s(hour, k=15,bs='cc') + 
              s(day_of_year, k=15,bs='cc')+
              s(solar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
              s(lunar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
              s(ice,k=6,bs='cr'),
            data=dat,
            method='ML',
            family=Gamma(link='log'),
            gamma=1.4,
            select=TRUE,
            knots=list(hour=c(0,24),day_of_year=c(0,365)))
summary(mcom)
gam.check(mcom)

mthickness= gam(Thickness_mean ~  
              s(hour, k=15,bs='cc') + 
              s(day_of_year, k=15,bs='cc')+
              s(solar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
              s(lunar_lux,k=6,bs='cr')+
              s(ice,k=6,bs='cr'),
            data=dat,
            method='ML',
            family=Gamma(link='log'),
            gamma=1.4,
            select=TRUE,
            knots=list(hour=c(0,24),day_of_year=c(0,365)))
summary(mthickness)
gam.check(mthickness)

preds_mdensity=as.data.frame(predict(mdensity,newdata=preds,type='response',
                                     se.fit=TRUE))
preds_mdensity$model='krill_density'
preds_mcom=as.data.frame(predict(mcom,newdata=preds,type='response',
                                 se.fit=TRUE))
preds_mcom$model='centre_of_mass'
preds_mthickness=as.data.frame(predict(mthickness,newdata=preds,type='response',
                                       se.fit=TRUE))
preds_mthickness$model='corrected_thickness'

preds_all2=rbind(preds_m1,preds_m2,preds_m3,
                 preds_mdensity,
                 preds_mthickness,
                 preds_mcom)

preds_all2$day_of_year=0:365
preds_all2$lower=preds_all2$fit-2*preds_all2$se.fit
preds_all2$upper=preds_all2$fit+2*preds_all2$se.fit

preds_all2$model<-factor(preds_all2$model, 
                             levels=c('krill_density','centre_of_mass',
                                     'corrected_thickness',
                                     'Bm_Ant_ABZ','Bm_D','BD'))
my_labels <- as_labeller(c(krill_density = "Krill density\n(g/m^3)",
                           centre_of_mass="Centre of mass\ndepth (m)",
                           corrected_thickness="Thickness\n(m)",
                           Bm_Ant_ABZ='ABW Song\n(Detections/h)',
                           Bm_D = "Downsweep\n(Detections/h)",
                           BD='Bioduck\n(Detections/h)'))

ggplot(data=preds_all2,aes(x=as.Date(day_of_year,origin='2021-01-01'),
                          y=fit,colour=model,group=model))+
  geom_line(linewidth=1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill=model),alpha=0.4,colour=NA)+
  facet_wrap(model~., scales = "free_y", nrow = length(unique(preds_all2$model)),
             strip.position = "left", 
             labeller=my_labels)+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = '%b')+
  scale_color_viridis_d(option="plasma",end = 0.7)+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option="plasma",end = 0.7)+
  ylab(NULL) + xlab(NULL)+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')

```

## Statistics calculated for model predictions
```{r Statistics}
mean(preds_all2$fit[preds_all2$model == 'krill_density' ])

# approximate lag between ABW song peak and krill density decline
lags <- preds_all2 %>%
  filter(model %in% c("Bm_Ant_ABZ","krill_density")) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(peak_day = day_of_year[which.max(fit)]) %>%
  summarise(lag_days = diff(peak_day))
lags

# define overlapping periods where both predicted fits > small threshold
thresholds <- preds_all2 %>%
  filter(model %in% c("Bm_Ant_ABZ", "BD")) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(thr = max(fit, na.rm = TRUE)*0.025) # 10% based on false detection rate for ABW

overlap_days <- preds_all2 %>%
  filter(model %in% c("Bm_Ant_ABZ", "BD")) %>%
  select(day_of_year, model, fit) %>%
  left_join(thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(detected = fit > thr) %>%
  select(-fit, -thr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = detected) %>%
  mutate(overlap = Bm_Ant_ABZ & BD) %>%
  summarise(
    n_overlap_days = sum(overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_days = n(),
    prop_overlap = mean(overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_overlap = 100 * prop_overlap
  )

overlap_days

# Join thresholds back and identify overlap days
overlap_day_list <- preds_all2 %>%
  filter(model %in% c("Bm_Ant_ABZ", "BD")) %>%
  select(day_of_year, model, fit) %>%
  left_join(thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(detected = fit > thr) %>%
  select(-fit, -thr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = detected) %>%
  filter(Bm_Ant_ABZ == TRUE & BD == TRUE) %>%
  pull(day_of_year)

overlap_dates <- as.Date(overlap_day_list, origin = "2021-01-01")
overlap_dates


# Seasonal summary of uncertainty
preds_all3 <- preds_all2 %>%
  mutate(season = case_when(
    day_of_year >= 80  & day_of_year < 172 ~ "spring",  # Mar 21 - Jun 20
    day_of_year >= 172 & day_of_year < 264 ~ "summer",  # Jun 21 - Sep 20
    day_of_year >= 264 & day_of_year < 355 ~ "autumn",  # Sep 21 - Dec 20
    TRUE                                   ~ "winter"   # Dec 21 - Mar 20
  ))

# Summarise mean and uncertainty for each model by season
seasonal_summary <- preds_all3 %>%
  group_by(model, season) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fit = mean(fit, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_fit   = mean(se.fit, na.rm = TRUE),        # mean standard error
    lower_ci = mean(lower, na.rm = TRUE),        # mean lower 95% CI
    upper_ci = mean(upper, na.rm = TRUE),        # mean upper 95% CI
    .groups = "drop"
  )

seasonal_summary

#Max krill density
sort(unique(preds_all2$fit[preds_all2$model == 'krill_density']), decreasing = TRUE)[65]
sort(unique(preds_all2$lower[preds_all2$model == 'krill_density']), decreasing = TRUE)[65]
sort(unique(preds_all2$upper[preds_all2$model == 'krill_density']), decreasing = TRUE)[65]

```

## Distance matrix and clustering on GAM

```{r Clusters on time series}
wide_preds <- reshape(preds_all2[, c("day_of_year", "fit", "model")],
                      timevar = "model",
                      idvar = "day_of_year",
                      direction = "wide")

pred_matrix <- wide_preds[, -1]  # remove day_of_year
scaled_matrix <- scale(pred_matrix)
dist_matrix <- dist(scaled_matrix, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2")  # or "complete", "average", etc.
plot(hc, main = "Hierarchical Clustering of GAM Predictions", xlab = "Days", sub = "")
fviz_nbclust(as.matrix(dist_matrix), FUN = hcut, method = "silhouette", hc_method = "average")

clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 2)  # Number of clusters from above = 2
wide_preds$cluster <- clusters

long_preds <- wide_preds %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("fit"),  # only pivot the fit columns
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "fit"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = sub("^fit\\.", "", variable)) %>%
  arrange(variable, day_of_year) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(run_id = cumsum(cluster != lag(cluster, default = first(cluster)))) %>%
  ungroup()


cluster_summary <- long_preds %>%
  group_by(cluster, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_days = n_distinct(day_of_year),
    mean_fit = mean(fit, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fit = sd(fit, na.rm = TRUE),
    start_day = min(day_of_year),
    end_day = max(day_of_year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, variable)

kable(cluster_summary, digits = 2, caption = "Summary of cluster properties")


preds_all2$cluster = long_preds$cluster
preds_all2$run_id = long_preds$run_id


ggplot(data = preds_all2, 
       aes(x = as.Date(day_of_year, origin = '2021-01-01'),
           y = fit,
           group = interaction(cluster, run_id),
           color = factor(cluster),
           fill = factor(cluster))) +
  # Shaded rectangles for overlap periods
  geom_rect(data = overlap_ranges,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey30", alpha = 0.3) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.4, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(model ~ ., 
             scales = "free_y", 
             nrow = length(unique(preds_all2$model)),
             strip.position = "left", 
             labeller = my_labels) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#0D0887", "2" = "#F87C36")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#0D0887", "2" = "#F87C36")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


```
